stage: Q4-1 fallback safety: declined construction selection must not cost the boundary layer

defect.symptom: Enabling --q4-termination-construction on sharp_trailing_edge dropped the whole mesh to pure Cut-cell fallback.

before.hybrid_detail: solver quality remains invalid after constrained repair: issues=8 min_face_weight=0.0339435 min_volume_ratio=0.01008

defect.root_cause: buildAutomaticHybridWithConstruction2D tried only the three termination growth ratios with the requested policy. A Q4-1 construction commit that later failed the final unchanged solver-quality gate therefore exhausted every hybrid candidate, and buildRobustH4Mesh2D went straight to pure Cut-cell. Q4-1 is an optional quality improvement, so its failure must not remove the boundary layer.

fix.behaviour: When Q4-1 selection was requested and every growth-ratio attempt with it enabled fails, the same geometry is retried once with enableTerminationConstructionQualitySelection=false before any caller may consider pure Cut-cell. No threshold, gate, wall geometry or Q3 pass was changed.

narrow_gap_q4_plus_q33_unchanged.note: byte-identical to the pre-fix Q4-1 narrow-gap artifact, so the accepted-Q4 path is untouched

generality_probe.purpose: Measure whether Q3/Q4 termination optimization applies beyond narrow-gap. Recorded as fact, not as a claim of convergence.

circle.conclusion: no local termination, so Q3/Q4 are inert; remaining hard faces are RemainderCut, an untreated family

concave_l.conclusion: Q3-1 transfers to a second geometry; the Q4-1 convex-union template finds candidates but none pass, consistent with the Q4-1 doc's own template-boundary conclusion

sharp_trailing_edge.conclusion: Q3-2/Q3-3 transfer weakly; Q3-1 pair agglomeration and Q4-1 do not apply here

regression_gates_added.unit_test: tests/h4_local_termination_test.cpp asserts the sharp taper stays Hybrid under a Q4-1 policy, reports the decline, and retains every non-Q4 boundary-layer cell
regression_gates_added.ci: cartmesh2d-ci.yml adds a q41_sharp_trailing_edge case with declined=true, accepted=0, layer-count equality against the baseline case, and OpenFOAM checkMesh coverage
